rule.episode_aggregation: mean complete windows within each episode, then equal mean of three seeds
rule.regression_label: use largest regression only when minimum episode gain is strictly negative
rule.replay_window: smallest eligible h10 window_start; never reselect for visual advantage
rule.frames: three observed support frames and tenth-query target, at recorded native frame indices
rule.error_map: mean squared standardized error per patch over 384 channels, then mean of three seeds
rule.error_scale: linear zero to maximum of all six displayed endpoint maps, no percentile clipping
rule.transport_panel: mean three-seed h10 row of transport matrix for fixed target patch (1,1); show its gate separately
rule.publication_gate: candidate only; completed verified 15-model campaign plus numeric checks plus actual visual review
